breaking_news.headline: U.S. job market slows in June
breaking_news.summary: Employers added 57,000 jobs in June, the Labor Department said on Friday, as jobs growth slowed from the previous two months, while the unemployment rate ticked down to 4.2%.

breaking_news.headline: Trump earned more than $1 billion from crypto — but his investors didn't fare so well
breaking_news.summary: President Trump earned more than $1 billion in 2025 from cryptocurrency ventures. But there are thousands of investors who bought into some of those cryptocurrencies, and they stand to lose big.

breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools

breaking_news.summary: The Airbnb-style company Swimply said there have been about 275,000 private pool reservations so far this year.

breaking_news.headline: But first, coffee: The drink that energized the American Revolution
breaking_news.summary: Colonial Americans were drinking coffee long before they dumped tea into Boston Harbor or fought a war for independence. The establishments that served it were already brewing revolutionary ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Egg producers settle with DOJ, states over price-fixing complaint
breaking_news.summary: Seventeen states and the Department of Justice have settled a case of alleged price-fixing by major egg producers. Egg prices soared in recent years but have since fallen sharply.

breaking_news.headline: Meet 'Project 2029' — and its war on the annoyance economy
breaking_news.summary: Remember Project 2025? Democrats are building their own governing blueprint, and one proposal takes aim at the "annoyance economy": robocalls, endless hold times, hidden fees and other everyday frustrations.

breaking_news.headline: Hungary's public news broadcasts halted in bid to scrap Orban-era propaganda
breaking_news.summary: The country's main state TV channel displayed a message saying it was "sorry" for lying on Tuesday.

breaking_news.headline: Ghana halts visit by South African president amid row over anti-migrant protests
breaking_news.summary: Many in Ghana feared his presence would lead to mass protests, and officials say it is postponed for now.

breaking_news.headline: New footage shown at Kirk hearing shows man on rooftop near shooting scene
breaking_news.summary: The preliminary hearing will determine whether Tyler Robinson, accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, will stand trial.

breaking_news.headline: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
breaking_news.summary: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.

breaking_news.headline: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine

breaking_news.headline: Trump looms large as Nato grapples with challenge of rearming Europe

breaking_news.summary: The US says the strikes are intended to impose "heavy costs", while Iran warns it will "take decisive measures" in response.
